concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-boleto-bancario-ios-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured Boleto Bancário iOS Components Sessions/Advanced add-on for shopper identity/due-date fields, BoletoComponent, voucher action and offline test/live status; source flags Advanced base-link mismatch.
warnings: Advanced integration-type link points to iOS Drop-in while the guide is Components; use matching Components base route.
Sessions uses optional deliverAt and Advanced uses optional deliveryDate for due date; do not normalize them into one field.
Child default five-day payment due date and overview's later 15-day open/Offer-cancelled status describe different lifecycle points.
